correction_log.trigger: X1 task-output audit before event-array analysis
correction_log.correction: The frozen 0.1 command epproc withoutoftime=yes creates an OOT event list instead of a normal event list; it does not emit both. Preserve that product as 0529_0093030201_EPN_S003_OutOfTimeEvts.ds, then run epproc withoutoftime=no to create the normal 0529_0093030201_EPN_S003_ImagingEvts.ds product.
correction_log.basis: Official SAS documentation states that the pipeline is run twice: first with withoutoftime=yes for the simulated OOT list, then with withoutoftime=no for normal calibrated events.

correction_log.trigger: X1 passed and before any count-rate array was read
correction_log.correction: Pin the previously unspecified 100-second bin phase to XMM mission TIME multiples of 100 seconds. For this observation use the common half-open range [152241400,152300200), covering every calibrated event-list TSTART/TSTOP.
correction_log.basis: A deterministic common bin phase prevents detector-specific first-event times from changing the flare classification.

correction_log.trigger: SAS rate-product schema audit before any flare-bin classification
correction_log.correction: SAS 22.1 evselect rate products carry detector-specific STDGTI extensions but no FRACEXP column. Compute each bin's overlap fraction independently for every detector STDGTI and use the minimum detector fraction for the frozen >=0.5 live-bin gate.
correction_log.basis: The minimum is a conservative, rate-independent aggregation that cannot admit a bin unless every active detector CCD meets the live-fraction gate.

purpose: Produce and quality-gate calibrated EPIC event lists, flare GTIs, one immutable point-source mask, and background-ready spectra before any gas-profile or gravity fit. The gate is independent of the HST centroid branch.

known_only_from_filenames_and_summary_me: MOS1 has one scheduled imaging exposure M1S001 with seven CCD image files.
MOS2 has one scheduled imaging exposure M2S002 with seven CCD image files.
pn has one scheduled imaging exposure PNS003 with twelve CCD image files.
The ODF is gzip-compressed and must be staged before SAS processing.

staging.rule: For every file in compressed_ODF, verify its archived size against acquisition provenance. Gzip-test every .gz file and decompress it into staged_ODF with only the final .gz suffix removed; byte-copy the uncompressed SUM.ASC. Never modify or delete the archived input.
staging.reject_if: Any gzip test, source size, staged file count, or deterministic source-to-staged mapping fails.

calibration_commands_in_order: cifbuild withccfpath=no analysisdate=2026-07-27 category=XMMCCF calindexset=$SAS_CCF fullpath=yes
odfingest odfdir=$SAS_ODF withodfdir=yes outdir=$ANALYSIS_ROOT usecanonicalname=yes writepath=yes usehousekeeping=yes findinstrumentmodes=yes oalcheck=yes
set SAS_ODF to the sole newly generated 0529_0093030201_SCX00000SUM.SAS after verifying OBS_ID and staged ODF path
epproc withoutoftime=yes; preserve the resulting PNS003 ImagingEvts product as PNS003 OutOfTimeEvts with checksum
epproc withoutoftime=no; retain the resulting PNS003 ImagingEvts as the normal calibrated event list

event_list_discovery.MOS1: the sole emproc calibrated event list 0529_0093030201_EMOS1_S001_ImagingEvts.ds
event_list_discovery.MOS2: the sole emproc calibrated event list 0529_0093030201_EMOS2_S002_ImagingEvts.ds
event_list_discovery.pn: the sole normal epproc event list 0529_0093030201_EPN_S003_ImagingEvts.ds generated with withoutoftime=no
event_list_discovery.pn_OOT: the preserved epproc event list 0529_0093030201_EPN_S003_OutOfTimeEvts.ds generated with withoutoftime=yes

calibration_gate.reject_if: Any required exposure has zero or multiple calibrated event-list matches, an exposure/instrument/filter/mode mismatch, SAS error, missing GTI, non-finite exposure, or absent pn OOT product. Do not substitute PPS events.

time_bin_alignment.rule: left edges are integer multiples of 100 seconds and bins are left-closed/right-open

flare_filter.live_fraction_source: minimum across detector-specific STDGTI overlap fractions in each aligned 100-second bin; SAS 22.1 rate tables have no FRACEXP column
flare_filter.iterative_rule: Starting from every live bin, retain bins no higher than min(fixed ceiling, median + 2.5*1.4826*MAD); recompute until membership is unchanged or 10 iterations. If MAD is zero, use the fixed ceiling only. No lower clipping and no manual GTI edits.
flare_filter.failure: Stop the XMM route if fewer than two instruments pass. Never widen GTIs or alter rate ceilings after viewing a profile.

point_source_mask.mask_radius_rule: For every pointlike detection meeting the likelihood gate in any band or instrument, use max(15 arcsec, min(60 arcsec, 1.5 times the local 80-percent encircled-energy radius)). The final mask is the union and is applied unchanged to all bands, instruments, annuli, and background regions.
point_source_mask.central_rule: Do not add or remove a central source by eye. The gas domain already excludes r<10 kpc; any automatically detected point source remains in the union mask.

background.method: Use ESAS filter-wheel-closed products with unexposed-corner normalization independently for each detector/CCD, plus a local outer-annulus spectral cross-check. Retain instrumental lines and residual soft-proton components as nuisance terms rather than subtracting them without uncertainty.
background.gate: Every fitted or corner-derived background scale must lie strictly inside [0.5,2.0], with no posterior pile-up at a bound. Fail an instrument whose corner area is absent or whose FWC product cannot be matched; require at least two instruments afterward.
forbidden: using the cluster radial profile to tune flare filtering
selecting a visually cleaner background region
dropping one detector after inspecting its fitted temperature
treating background-subtracted counts as independent Poisson data

spectral_annuli.deterministic_merging: Traverse outward from 10 kpc and merge adjacent candidate rings until the combined passing-instrument, background-model net count estimate is at least 2000 and S/N is at least 5. Close that annulus and continue. Never split, move, or merge an annulus after a temperature or density fit. If the final remainder fails, merge it inward once.
spectral_annuli.fit_statistic: joint Poisson source-plus-background likelihood (XSPEC W-stat/C-stat equivalent), not chi-square on background-subtracted spectra
spectral_annuli.cluster_model: cross-calibration constant times tbabs times single-temperature apec at frozen z=0.235 in each projected annulus; metallicity is shared between adjacent low-information annuli through a hierarchical nuisance prior, never fixed after seeing a fit
spectral_annuli.response_rule: Generate one RMF and extended-source ARF for every accepted instrument-annulus pair using the same frozen point-source mask and detector map.
spectral_annuli.projection: Use the same joint posterior draws for emissivity deprojection, electron density, spherical gas mass, and projected gas surface density. Preserve all cross-annulus and density-temperature covariance.
spectral_annuli.failure: Fail if fewer than five annuli meet counts, S/N, temperature, density, response, background, and covariance gates. Do not publish a diagonal or one-anchor substitute.

stage_outcomes.outcome: One dated CIF/SOSF and exactly one calibrated event list for each of M1S001, M2S002, and PNS003, plus pn OOT.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: All calibration identity and task-exit gates pass.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Stop on any identity ambiguity; do not use PPS events as a replacement.

stage_outcomes.outcome: At least two EPIC instruments retain >=15 ks and >=25% raw exposure under frozen flare rules; all their background scales lie in [0.5,2].
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Exposure, mask, corner, FWC, and outer-annulus gates pass independently of gas fits.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: If fewer than two pass, RX J2129 remains structural-only and the route moves to MACS J1206.

stage_outcomes.outcome: At least five 10-500 kpc annuli pass counts, S/N, response, temperature, density, posterior-draw, and covariance gates.
stage_outcomes.advance_if: Publish one source-traceable gas likelihood and authorize observable-package assembly only.
stage_outcomes.rethink_if: Retain event/background diagnostics but do not claim a gas likelihood.
